# Geometry-aware approach to statistical-arbitrage basket construction

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #852. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed geometry-aware approach to statistical-arbitrage basket construction: Score relative mispricing across a basket of securities and construct hedged or market-neutral positions, subject to borrow, liquidity, and transaction-cost constraints. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
